title: volume
intro:
A subset of 3D space.
   Used by Irrigation @ event volume (see 107.10, page 604) .

sections.name: box
sections.desc:
A volume defined by intervals on each axis. By default, the intervals fill the entire
axis. You can modify this by setting the parameters.
sections.used: action table volume (see 15.54, page 92) , action extern fertigation volume (see 15.9, page 78) , action extern subsoil volume (see 15.10, page 79) , action irrigate subsoil volume (see 15.20, page 83) , log select volume (see 52.3, page 283) , select flow volume (see 80.5, page 433) , and select volume base volume (see 80.16, page 436) .

sections.text:
A volume defined by intervals on each axis. By default, the intervals fill the entire
axis. You can modify this by setting the parameters.
    Used by action table volume (see 15.54, page 92) , action extern fertigation
volume (see 15.9, page 78) , action extern subsoil volume (see 15.10, page 79) ,
action irrigate subsoil volume (see 15.20, page 83) , log select volume (see 52.3,
page 283) , select flow volume (see 80.5, page 433) , and select volume base volume
(see 80.16, page 436) .
